name: consistency-violation-data-type-external-incomplete-reference
description: A data type stub whose `DEST` is not the one this layer admits. The stub loads, as its interface twin does, and the model rule holds the pair to `IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE`, the one `DEST` a type stub may carry in this contract.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model. The change set creates one data type stub whose `external_dest` names an application data type.

authorization.notes: The scope covers the one address exactly, so the refusal is the model rule and not the authorization boundary.

input.intent: Carry the speed type as a reference into the rest of the delivery.

expected.notes: One address, at the field the repair is about. `IMPLEMENTATION-DATA-TYPE` is the whole admitted set in this contract: a stub stands where a data element's or an argument's `implementation_type`, or a reference type's `base`, names an implementation type, while a value type's `base`, a record field, an array's element type and a mapping set's two sides never admit one. As for the interface twin, the rule judges the pair and never the target it names.
